q: Where can I find information about the event program?
a: The full program is on this site, and it is updated regularly. Announcements are also made by email, so sign up to EDA's mailing list to receive the latest NEDC26 news.
A list of recommended accommodation options, including the delegate rate at the conference venue, is on the accommodation page.

q: What time does NEDC26 start and finish?
a: Day 2 and Day 3 commence at 8:30am and conclude around 5pm. There is an exciting speaker lined up for the final session on Day 3, so stick around for it.

q: Where can I review my registration information?
a: Refer to your original confirmation email, which sets out your registration information. An app will be released closer to the event that will also let you access your registration information and social function attendance.

q: Where can I find my ticket?
a: NEDC26 is a ticketless event. Your confirmation email confirms your attendance.

q: Are the social functions included in my ticket?
a: Full registration includes the NEDC26 Welcome Reception and the two day conference. For full registrations purchased before 2 September 2026, attendance at the National Economic Development Awards for Excellence Gala Dinner is also included. The Gala Dinner is now at capacity and is no longer included with new full registrations. Single day registration does not include access to social functions, which can be purchased during registration.

q: When does the early bird rate close?
a: Early bird rates closed on 28 August 2026.

q: Can I purchase a ticket at NEDC26?
a: Tickets must be pre purchased through this website and may sell out due to venue capacity. Register in advance to avoid disappointment.

q: I cannot pay by credit card. Is there an option to receive an invoice?
a: Yes. During registration there is an option to pay by invoice, and you can enter a PO number.

q: If the event is cancelled, how do I receive a refund?
a: In the unlikely event of cancellation, Economic Development Australia will contact you and an automatic refund will be returned to your original method of payment.

q: I can no longer attend NEDC26. Can I get a refund?
a: For information about cancellations and refunds, see the terms and conditions, or contact the events team.
